description:
Problem: a Dispute: reply triggers nothing, because oracle-verdict.yml does not subscribe to review-comment events; the dispute waits for an unrelated push or rerun (median 47 minutes, up to 19 hours). Dispute reruns consume the 6-per-day manual budget with backoff (retry.py:83-104). After two forced rounds the only exit is a stand-in that waives the whole head with no per-finding reasoning (protocol.py:353-387).

Outcome (owner Q5 and 2026-10-26 follow-ups):
- No new workflow trigger: review-comment events run PR-controlled workflow code. After a Dispute: reply, a same-head /oracle-review with an open dispute takes the dispute path through the driver, and the cron sweep re-dispatches heads with an open, unanswered dispute.
- Up to 2 dispute rounds per patch digest (the digest defined by oracle-carry-byte-identical-20261026) are exempt from the manual budget and backoff.
- A finding maintained twice on the same digest becomes escalated; the gate's waiting message names the exact owner action.
- An owner comment 'Oracle adjudication: WITHDRAW D<n> - <reason>' or 'Oracle adjudication: MAINTAIN D<n> - <reason>' from the attester account (same checks as stand-ins: exact grammar, unedited, posted after the escalation, for the current head) records a terminal per-finding disposition. The comment triggers a verdict-driver re-decision with no reviewer attempt, which posts a new review and status; the gate never parses findings. The gate and verdict issue_comment filters and the gate concurrency group (oracle-gate.yml:31,38) admit the adjudication grammar. WITHDRAW stops the finding blocking; MAINTAIN closes the dispute.
- Stand-in scope enforced in the gate (owner 2026-10-26): _is_standin rejects a stand-in on a head whose latest decisive verdict lists open findings; stand-ins remain for absence, oversize and refusal; docs/agent/merge-authority.md and docs/agent/emergency-merge.md say so.
- The merge digest lists adjudications and flags any adjudication without a prior Owner instruction comment.

Decision gates:
1. No new workflow trigger and no PR-controlled workflow: the dispute path runs only from develop's verdict workflow (comment-triggered same-head run, dispatch or sweep).
2. Adjudication identity reuses the stand-in attester checks; record that, because agents share the owner account (owner-agent-identity-20261021 is blocked), the control is audit-only like stand-ins, and require a prior Owner instruction comment naming the PR, head and finding.
3. Prove an author cannot loop disputes on one patch beyond 2 exempt rounds.

Item guardrails: no change to the evidence rules (previous dispute item); no ruleset change; agents post an adjudication only when the owner names the PR, the head, the finding and the decision in the current request, after an Owner instruction comment.

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. Never use git stash (refs/stash is shared across worktrees). Commit as Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>, staging explicit paths only; no git add -A, no --no-verify, no SKIP, no agent trailers. Durable text (commits, PR bodies, docs, code) carries no tracker ids, session labels or plan references. Maintained code has no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check). Before publishing run make docs-reference-inventory-check, make doc-contracts-guard and make pr-preflight, and self-review with the code review action, fixing every Critical and Required finding. Publish only with make pr-open: never gh pr create, a raw push-and-open, or a PR-body override line; if make pr-open refuses, stop and report the exact refusal instead of routing around it. Until oracle-omp-pin-single-source-20261026 merges, make pr-open may run only with PATH prefixed by the darwin-arm64 omp 18.12.1 build recorded in that item (SHA-256 fa41b27d434380e99b713e4f9ced0f73eb1fc0c409fdf23a57c119971d24bac5, from https://build.stencil.so/d/omp/20261017-231446-291e055/omp-darwin-arm64), verified with shasum immediately before use; never any other side-loaded omp. Close out only with oracle SHIP on the exact head, every oracle thread answered (reply naming the fixing SHA, then resolve) and make pr-arm; never raw gh pr merge or a ruleset or settings change, and never a stand-in, adjudication or backoff reset unless the owner names the PR and head (and the finding) in the current request after an Owner instruction comment. Never edit, delete, dismiss or minimise an oracle review, review comment or commit status, and never post a commit status by hand. Run /oracle-review only on a pending or absent head, or after a Dispute: reply with file:line counter-evidence; never to re-roll a decided head. Do not close, reopen, rerun or rebase other PRs. Until oracle-gateway-cloud-builder-access-20261025 merges, publish only from the owner's Mac. Rollback: if a change to the verdict or gate workflows or to the local review breaks its first live run after merge in a way that blocks other PRs, stop, run make trunk-revert PR=<n>, and report to the owner, who chooses between an absence stand-in and the broken-oracle-gate procedure. Never print tokens, keys, or the gateway URL or hostname; never spend model quota outside the review harness. Owner decisions are recorded in context and in the decisions file; a step that would contradict one stops and asks the owner.

Decision gate 4 (owner 2026-10-27): a head that HOLDs because an App review or comment was edited keeps the owner stand-in path, like absence and refusal, even with open findings. The stand-in rejection for open findings must exempt edit-HOLD heads.
